meta.name: client-health-dashboard
meta.description: Generates a comprehensive client health overview across all accounts. Reads CRM data, support tickets, usage metrics, billing, and engagement logs. Calculates health scores, trend direction, and RAG status per client. Outputs a sorted risk report with recommended actions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成客户健康概览与风险报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要跨账户监控客户状态并识别风险客户。
copy.tagline_en: Generate client health overview and risk reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor client health across accounts and identify at-risk clients.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会从 CRM、工单、使用数据、账单和沟通记录中收集信息，为每个客户计算健康分数，并生成一份按风险排序的报告，包含红黄绿状态和具体建议。
howto.when: 当你要求生成客户健康报告时触发，例如说“生成客户健康概览”或“检查客户风险”。

say.text: 生成所有客户的健康报告。
只检查客户 A 和客户 B 的健康状况。
say.note: 报告将仅包含这两个客户。

say.text: 用我上传的 CSV 文件生成健康报告。
say.note: Claude 会优先解析你提供的文件作为数据源。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude collects data from CRM, support tickets, usage metrics, billing, and communication logs, calculates a health score for each client, and generates a risk-sorted report with RAG status and actionable recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a client health report, e.g., 'Generate client health overview' or 'Check client risk.'

say_en.text: Generate a health report for all clients.
say_en.note: Claude will gather data and output client-health-report.md.

say_en.text: Check health only for Client A and Client B.
say_en.note: The report will include only those two clients.

say_en.text: Use the uploaded CSV file to generate the health report.
say_en.note: Claude will prioritize parsing your file as a data source.
